mission.disclosure: Bonjour, je suis un assistant vocal automatique. Cet appel est passé par une intelligence artificielle.
goals: Wait through the menu and the queue until a person answers
Then connect the owner so they can talk to that person
constraints: Do not hang up on hold music or a recorded queue message
fallbacks: If it is clearly voicemail: leave a short message and hang up
If the owner does not answer: apologize and continue

handoff.connect_line: Un instant, je vous mets en relation avec le propriétaire.
handoff.context: L'agent du support est en ligne.
